summary: CR-013 Food Court Report feature verified. All features working correctly: page loads at /reports-module/food-court, station dropdown populated with BAR/KDS/OTHER options, station filter changes table data (BAR: 99 orders, KDS: 1013 orders), KPI strip shows station-scoped totals, TOTALS row present, tabs (All Orders/Settled) work, S7 header pattern implemented (Cabinet Grotesk, bordered date range, green Apply, grouped presets, orange Download). No regression on Order Ledger (S6) - still loads correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: FoodCourtMockup.jsx is well-structured - clones Order Ledger layout with station filter addition
foodCourtService.js correctly re-aggregates orders per station using item.station field
Station list extracted from all items across all orders - handles multi-station orders correctly
Auto-selects first station when data loads (stationInitialized state)
Uses same order-logs-report API as S6 - no new API endpoints needed
Sidebar entry correctly added at line 86 under Insights menu
